eyebrow: Still just NumPy to the caller
code:
import numpy as np
import quantlib_cpp as qc

spots = np.array(
    [95.0, 100.0, 105.0, 110.0])
payoffs = qc.vectorized_payoff(
    spots, strike=100.0)
print(payoffs)
# array([0., 0., 5., 10.])
caption: The caller never knows the computation happened in compiled C++ against raw memory.
